precision: Target W8A8; Draft FP16; GDN recurrent cache FP32 for ordinary and DFlash inputs/outputs; conv and KV FP16
valid_rows: INT16[1], call-local valid rows; never cumulative KV length
verify_policy: first GDR -> Target Top1 -> first-mismatch acceptance -> second GDR effective_length=a+1 -> complete state outputs
verify_device_outputs: all Target states after a+1 inputs
verify_discard_t<layer>_recurrent: 24 raw first-pass FP32[1,32,128,128] outputs, appended in linear-layer order
verify_discard_policy: output_final_state=True; independent reusable device buffers; no host allocation, H2D/D2H, reset clearing, cache input, or current/next swap; only second-pass state is committed
verify_discard_export_audit: air/verify_chunk/verify-discard-outputs.json: raw first-pass GDR state reaches each declared GE NetOutput slot before AIR save
commit_capsules: internal graph intermediates; no separate OM or host transfer
draft_policy: one Draft OM; 64-row gear for long-prompt preparation, final prompt block in first useful proposal call, then 16-row generation gear
draft_outputs: draft_top1 INT64[1,15], first K valid, unused tail zero
cache_policy: logical capacity C, multiple of 64, 64 <= C <= 32704; physical C+64 reserves scratch; prompt_length+max_new_tokens <= C
target_kv_update: CacheUpdate in paged layout; prefill one aligned 64-row page; decode one row; verify 16 chained single-row writes with per-row block/offset
draft_kv_update: ScatterElements in dense [B,H,C,D] context cache; 12 writes
runtime_policy: load selected models once; persistent current/next device banks; complete verify before atomic host publication; errors invalidate request until reset
ordered_tensor_shapes: derived from loaded modules; frozen in AIR metadata.tensor_abi and deployment-manifest.json
runtime_input_abi: public-tensor-storage-identity-v1; normalize GE Data index/order; only Draft features axis 1 may be -1; runtime validates exact 16/64 gear descriptors
target_gates: receiver all_seq_lengths_q INT64 static capacity, absent pse_shift, and runtime causal/valid-prefix mask
custom GE operators and exact Ascend310P ATC variant available
native ordinary vs OM ordinary vs DFlash zero token-ID/EOS mismatches
zero/partial/all acceptance, valid_rows=1, long prompt, cross-block cache
ten stable successful target repetitions after three warmups
performance_limitations: single Draft prefill needs ceil(input_tokens/64)-1 full preparation calls; discarded proposals are excluded from acceptance
Draft dense scatter and current/next OM state buffers can still involve full-cache copies
verify uses per-row CacheUpdate until multi-row cross-page ABI is validated
separate OMs do not automatically share weight allocations
ordinary_state_policy: ordinary Chunk GDR prefill/decode preserves FP32 state without FP16 round trip
shared_bundle_policy: two route manifests in one directory reference three identical common artifacts; source/configuration/ABI/ATC identity and options must match
draft_valid_rows: INT16[1], 0..R where R is the selected 16/64 gear; generation appends 1..16 rows
memory_policy: reuse existing 64-row feature buffer and current/next KV banks; one Draft model plus CANN dynamic-control input; physical gear weights/workspace/peak require device validation
native_plan_policy: draft_prefill_policy single_draft16_64_gears is mandatory; re-export AIR, recompile OMs and regenerate old plans
